coverage.target: Not applicable to this packaging unit. NFR1 is the Performance group (response time, throughput, resource ceiling). u6-tooling-and-delivery owns formatter/linter config, pre-commit, hosted pipeline, and deploy procedure; it handles no HTTP request and measures no application latency. Performance leaves bind u3-write-path, u4-reporting, and u5-presentation. The stage produces_kinds filter also excludes a performance artifact for packaging.

NFR3.5.1, NFR3.5.2 — packaging binds WAL-aware stop-then-copy backup and smoke-gated deploy success that preserve audit history under NFR3.5. NFR3.1/NFR3.2 bind u3-write-path (and NFR3.2.1 in u2-domain-vocabulary). NFR3.3/NFR3.4/NFR3.5a/NFR3.6 bind u1-foundation migration/backfill ownership; packaging does not author migration SQL.

Not applicable to this packaging unit. NFR4 is the Accessibility group (WCAG / FR11.1 screen gates). u6-tooling-and-delivery renders no UI and serves no route; accessibility binds u5-presentation. The stage produces_kinds filter also excludes accessibility-oriented artifacts outside this unit's security/tech-stack pair.

NFR5.1.1 — packaging must not introduce container/IaC or a second topology, preserving C4/NFR5.1 single-host deployment. NFR5.2 binds u4-reporting counting path; NFR5.3 binds u5-presentation asset list. No separate scalability artifact is produced for packaging.

NFR6.1.1, NFR6.2.1 — pre-commit and GitHub Actions enforce the POC suite baseline and the 80% line-coverage floor. NFR6.3–NFR6.6 bind application units' test authorship (identifiers, test-first rebuilds, migration fixtures, err.code assertions), not packaging gates.
